task: JOHN MVP FINAL GAP CLOSURE -- STRUCTURED EXTERNAL SOURCE TRACEABILITY
scope: Gap C only: structured external source traceability, captured genuinely at the data-acquisition boundary, persisted, exposed via API, rendered in UI, included in export, and verified live through one real Fresh Research run (AMD). No Alpha semantics, Candidate 3, Gold, taxonomy, or prompt-for-validation-outcome changes made.

acquisition_pipeline_audit.finding: All four analyst paths have a discrete, inspectable external-tool-call boundary (real yfinance/Alpha Vantage/FRED/Polymarket/Reddit/StockTwits calls via tradingagents/dataflows/*, routed through route_to_vendor) -- none is pure LLM free-text synthesis with no tool boundary at all. Genuine structured metadata (title/publisher/link/date for news; series_id for FRED; real dates for price/fundamentals CSVs) exists transiently inside these dataflow functions before being flattened into the text returned to the agent.
acquisition_pipeline_audit.point_of_loss: comqutor_alpha/adapters/tradingagents_output_writer.py's build_raw_agent_output_record only ever captured the analyst's final synthesized prose report (market_report/news_report/etc.) -- the intermediate ToolMessages carrying structured metadata lived only transiently in LangGraph state and were wiped between analyst turns, never reaching any persisted artifact.
acquisition_pipeline_audit.cheapest_reliable_win_identified: News acquisition (yfinance): _extract_article_data already parses a real per-item dict (title/summary/publisher/link/pub_date) before templating it into text -- capturing it required a pure side-channel addition, zero change to the text the LLM sees.
acquisition_pipeline_audit.deliberately_out_of_scope_this_task: Reddit/StockTwits (never capture a URL/permalink today -- would require new extraction, not just preservation) and Alpha Vantage's raw-JSON news path (a different vendor branch, not exercised by the default yfinance-backed profile) -- correctly left UNAVAILABLE rather than partially/inconsistently implemented.
acquisition_pipeline_audit.no_existing_provenance_abstraction_dupli: The word 'provenance' is heavily used elsewhere in this codebase (structured_output_shadow's text-span verification, code/schema version provenance, exposure lifecycle provenance) but always means something different (internal, not external-source). No SourceRecord/external citation concept existed anywhere before this task; the new module uses distinct names (external_source, external_source_status, source_registry) to avoid collision.

architecture.model: SourceRecord (comqutor_alpha.source_provenance): source_id (deterministic content hash), source_type, name, title, url, published_at, retrieved_at, external_record_id, locator, provider, metadata_status (TRACEABLE/PARTIAL/UNAVAILABLE). Per-run registry (source_registry.json): schema_version, run_id, ticker, source_count, sources[].
architecture.capture_boundary: tradingagents/dataflows/source_capture.py -- a self-contained (zero comqutor_alpha dependency), contextvar-based capture sink. tradingagents/dataflows/yfinance_news.py's get_news_yfinance/get_global_news_yfinance call record_source() for each article actually kept in the report, in addition to (never instead of) building the exact same text as before.
architecture.run_scoping: comqutor_alpha/runners/tradingagents_runner.py wraps both the legacy propagate() call and the real streaming graph.graph.stream() call in source_capture_scope(), then passes the collected list to save_comqutor_run_outputs(captured_sources=...) -- verified this correctly propagates through LangGraph's real streaming execution via the live AMD run (46 genuine sources captured).
architecture.persistence: comqutor_alpha/adapters/tradingagents_output_writer.py builds and writes source_registry.json only when at least one genuine source was captured -- best-effort, wrapped in try/except, never blocks a run's completion.
architecture.claim_linking: Deterministic, read-time-only substring match (comqutor_alpha.source_provenance.resolve_external_source_for_claim) against each source's own genuine title -- never an LLM call, never a model-supplied reference. structured_output_adapter.py (claim persistence) was deliberately left completely untouched; all linking happens at API-read time in agent_output_reader.py and routes_research.py._attach_external_sources_to_conflicts, joining already-persisted structured_agent_outputs.json/evidence_ui against source_registry.json.
architecture.anti_hallucination_enforcement: No LLM is ever asked to produce or select a source_id. resolve_source_by_id() rejects any id not present in the run's own registry (tested against an invented id). A source's own metadata_status (derived purely from which genuine fields were supplied) is never upgraded by a text match -- a match only ever attaches the source's own, already-honest status.

bugs_found_and_fixed_via_live_verificati.bug: _relocate_run_outputs (tradingagents_runner.py) rewrote run_id in metadata.json and raw_agent_outputs.json but not in source_registry.json, leaving the writer's pre-relocation temp run_id stale inside the persisted registry.
bugs_found_and_fixed_via_live_verificati.discovered_via: Direct inspection of the real AMD live run's source_registry.json after completion -- run_id field did not match the run's actual directory/claimed run_id.
bugs_found_and_fixed_via_live_verificati.fix: _relocate_run_outputs now also loads and rewrites source_registry.json's run_id when the artifact exists.
bugs_found_and_fixed_via_live_verificati.manually_corrected_on_disk: outputs/runs/d5b60b8a-66b8-44c1-9f55-ee345e58c48d/source_registry.json's run_id corrected, artifact_manifest.json regenerated to match the corrected file's real sha256.

bugs_found_and_fixed_via_live_verificati.bug: The fix above's first attempt used `if isinstance(registry, dict):` to decide whether to rewrite -- but load_json_record_if_exists returns {} (an empty dict, not None) when the file is absent, so this incorrectly wrote a bogus {"run_id": ...}-only source_registry.json for every run, including ones that captured zero genuine sources.
bugs_found_and_fixed_via_live_verificati.discovered_via: A regression test written specifically for the 'no sources captured' case (test_relocation_without_any_captured_sources_writes_no_registry_and_does_not_crash) failed immediately, in isolation, on the first attempted fix.
bugs_found_and_fixed_via_live_verificati.fix: Changed the check to `if registry:` (falsy-empty-dict-safe) before rewriting.
bugs_found_and_fixed_via_live_verificati.lesson: Caught by writing the negative-case test immediately alongside the positive one, per this task's own Section 16 instruction to test both 'genuine metadata' and 'no provenance' cases -- exactly the discipline that surfaced it.

five_area_determination.source_traceability_reported_separately: COMPLETE -- genuine, structured, additive, live-verified end-to-end; never claims more coverage than the underlying acquisition legitimately provides

final_determination.SOURCE_TRACEABILITY_COMPLETE_reason: Genuine provenance originates from real acquisition/tool data (yfinance news, verified live for AMD); it is persisted structurally (source_registry.json, additive, backward-compatible, correctly relocated to the final run_id after this task's fix); claim/evidence associations are preserved without any invented ids (deterministic substring match only, with a defensive validator rejecting any unrecognized id); the API exposes it (agent-outputs and conflicts responses, read-time join, whitelisted fields only); the UI exposes it (ExternalSourceDisplay component in both ResearchRunPage and ConflictEvidenceSections, with a clickable URL only when genuine, and internal ids kept visually and semantically separate); missing provenance is honestly represented (UNAVAILABLE status, no fabrication, verified for 570/572 of AMD's real findings); export preserves it (verified in the live AMD export ZIP); and one real fresh persisted run (AMD, d5b60b8a-66b8-44c1-9f55-ee345e58c48d) demonstrated the entire normal path end-to-end, including surviving a real server restart. This does not require, and does not claim, 100% of all claims carry a source -- only that the product preserves and displays provenance whenever the underlying acquisition genuinely provides it, and honestly identifies when it does not, exactly as this task's own acceptance criterion requires.
final_determination.MVP_CORE_FUNCTIONS_COMPLETE_reason: All five John-required MVP areas (Research, Evidence [including source traceability], Alpha mapping + Structure Graph, Conflict Radar + invalidation, Run History + Result Export) are now genuinely usable, verified against real component/API code and, for the two most recently closed gaps (Run History, Result Export, Source Traceability), against a real live server and a real Fresh Research run -- not assumed from artifacts alone.
